denial.falsifier: Any measurement showing 14 or more FP values simultaneously live anywhere in the target body, or any source form that emits the stfd/lfd pair (ours to 104 instructions, frame 136) by RAISING FP pressure rather than by changing the promotion class of a single local.
denial.premise_measurement: Live-FP census read off `python tools/gdl/fnasm.py game/mb/mb_camera.c MBWorldToScreen3D`, zero builds, whole body. At the target's f31 consumer `@0x150 fmuls f0,f12,f31` exactly TEN values are live across the point: f1 (def @0x12c, use @0x154), f2 (@0x14c -> @0x154), f3 (@0x144 -> @0x158), f5 (@0x134 -> @0x158), f6 (@0x130 -> @0x164), f10 (@0xc0 -> @0x158), f11 (@0xe8 -> @0x16c), f12 (@0x140 -> @0x150), f13 (@0x148 -> @0x170), f31 (@0x13c -> @0x150). At the body's true PEAK, `@0x14c fnmsubs f2,f11,f4,f2`, the count is ELEVEN (the same set plus f4, def @0x10c, use @0x14c). At the moment f31 is DEFINED, `@0x13c lfs f31,212(r10)`, five volatiles are free: f0, f8 (dead after @0x134), f9 (dead after @0x134), f12 and f13 (not yet defined). The predecessor record's own threshold is 'if that count is 14 or fewer, the pressure story is wrong'; the measured count is 10-11 against 14 available volatiles, so the bank is never full and MWCC reached f31 with volatiles to spare. Probe 1 (the mandated viewport[3][0] local) then REGRESSED real 84 -> 108 while leaving insns at T104/O102 and the multiset delta at exactly `target-only: +1 lfd +1 stfd` -- the third consecutive probe on this mechanism to leave the deciding observable untouched (axes A and B of the predecessor record are the first two).
denial.scope: The REGISTER-PRESSURE MECHANISM for f31 in MBWorldToScreen3D: the premise that the target holds a fifteenth simultaneously-live FP quantity and that adding or relocating a named f32 local will exhaust f0-f13 and force MWCC to allocate the callee-saved f31. It denies nothing about the arithmetic, the PBSCREEN layout, the pad, an unrecovered local, or a non-pressure route to a callee-saved FPR.

hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: Count the distinct FP registers written in each stream from the two fnasm dumps, zero builds. If our object ever uses f13, the 'we are two registers short' framing is wrong and the gap is one register, not two. Measured this run: target writes f0,f1,f2,f3,f4,f5,f6,f7,f8,f9,f10,f11,f12,f13,f31 = 15; ours writes f0..f12 = 13.
hypothesis.screened_against_target: no -- every register, offset and instruction quoted above is read from the target's and our own fnasm dumps and is accurate, but the promotion-class theory itself has NOT been probed: no source form was tried this run whose stated aim was to change a local's promotion class rather than to raise pressure, and the GPR-side analogy is an observation about this function, not a tested lever.
hypothesis.statement: f31 here is a CLASS decision, not a pressure decision: MWCC promoted exactly one FP value into the callee-saved bank while three to five volatiles sat free, which is the same thing it does on the GPR side of this function. The GPR control, read out of the target stream with each register's defining instruction beside its offset: `@0x14 addi r29,r3,0` (the dst parameter), `@0x18 addi r31,r4,0` (the world parameter) and `@0x1c lwz r30,0(0)  @gWinGlobals(EMB_SDA21)` (the globals local) -- three USER VARIABLES sitting in the callee-saved bank, while the save-set range r16-r28 is untouched and every expression temporary rides a volatile, `@0x0 mflr r0` included. The target uses FIFTEEN distinct FP registers -- f0 through f13 plus f31 -- and our object uses THIRTEEN, f0 through f12, with no f13 at all; that two-register gap, not a full bank, is what the next lane must close. The next axis is therefore whatever makes ONE f32 local a register-promotion candidate rather than an expression temporary: the target's f31 holds camera->viewport[1][1], defined `@0x13c lfs f31,212(r10)` and consumed once at `@0x150 fmuls f0,f12,f31`, which is our yDenomB -- already a named local in our source and NOT promoted, our counterpart being the volatile `@0x128 lfs f10,212(r10)`.
